dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, exhibiting a deepening spline curve toward the mid-point before tapering to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with a very small curvature radius, appearing pointed at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep upward slope measured at approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin base width is approximately 0.8 times the vertical height from base to apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curve with a large radius extending from the dorsal cranium to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stout rostral projection with a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1:1 visible from this angle.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle of approximately 140 degrees between the melon and the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several circular pale patches visible on the lateral skin, specifically one prominent mark posterior to the dorsal fin and another mid-body.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive counter-shading boundary between the dark dorsal and light ventral regions.
